name: Reika Final ~Juuetsu no Kioku~ Reika Cow Training
original_name: 麗佳Final -獣悦の記憶- 麗佳牝牛調教
source:
Reika was being trained every day at a mansion in the mountains. One day, she was taken to a livestock farmer near the mansion. It was a dealer that handled breeding bulls, a so-called breeding bull dealer. With the raging bulls behind her, the man gently said to Reika...
"From today, you'll be in charge of satisfying their sexual desires." From then on, the screams of the girl never ceased in that barn.
